_comment: Canonical free-text rubrics for JustEnough answer equivalence checking. Human-approved factual ground truth.

required_facts: no fraudulent or unauthorized charges identified
BS-1-B.scoring_rubric: Answers must correctly identify the recorded transactions (Swiggy food, Priya Patel transfer, Apollo Pharmacy) and note the absence of fraudulent anomalies.

BS-3-B.task: Which transactions look unusual and why?
BS-3-B.scoring_rubric: Answers must identify the highest outgoing debits (ATM cash withdrawal 5000 INR and Amazon retail 3499 INR) or compare against incoming salary credit.

PS-1-A.task: Explain why my take-home pay changed
PS-1-A.scoring_rubric: Answers must account for net pay (87,450 INR) as gross salary (97,000 INR) reduced by deductions (PF, Professional Tax, Income Tax totaling 9,550 INR).

PS-2-A.task: What changed between my gross salary and take-home pay?
PS-2-A.scoring_rubric: Answers must specify the difference of 11,800 INR between gross (108,000 INR) and net (96,200 INR), attributable to PF, TDS, and Gratuity.

RA-1-A.task: Summarize the key terms of my rent agreement
RA-1-A.scoring_rubric: Answers must capture the rent amount (38,000 INR/month due on the 5th), refundable deposit (114,000 INR), lock-in period (11 months), and notice period (1 month).

IL-1-A.task: Summarize the important information in this document
IL-1-A.scoring_rubric: Answers must summarize clinical findings (uncontrolled Type 2 Diabetes, HbA1c 8.4%, Fasting Glucose 168 mg/dL), investigation bill (6,500 INR), and 24-month pre-existing condition condition.
